document.abstract: In the 12 months before September 2024, the Digital Video Broadcasting (DVB) Project continued fulfilling its mission of designing open technical specifications for delivering digital television and other broadcast and broadband services. Based in Switzerland, the association brings together representatives of the entire media delivery value chain, content providers and technology vendors, network operators, service providers, regulatory bodies, trade associations, research institutes, and universities, with 135+ member organizations at the time of writing.
